relations: If the upper platen presses downward, the wooden stack compresses and its height reduces.
Sustained compression may cause the planks to buckle, split, or bulge sideways.
The plastic wrapping stretches or tears as the boards deform under the load.
The striped base supports the stack, resisting the downward force from above.
